mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,id,max_requests,requests_used,max_cost_micros,cost_held,state,policy_version,plan_snapshot,plan_digest,phase_b_snapshot,phase_b_digest FROM evaluation_budget WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{run} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,queue_limit,running_limit,model_limit,tool_limit,token_limit,storage_limit,queued,running,model_used,tool_used,token_held,storage_held,cost_held,cost_limit,media_checkpoint_held,question_tasks_held,question_tasks_limit,todo_storage_held,todo_storage_limit,directory_storage_held,directory_storage_limit,history_storage_held,history_storage_limit FROM tenant_budget WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(d.actual_cost,d.reserved_cost)),0) FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run} AND (t.models_used<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND d.task_id=t.id) OR t.cost_held<>(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(d.actual_cost,d.reserved_cost)),0) FROM model_dispatch d WHERE d.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND d.task_id=t.id))
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_held),0) FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(models_used),0) FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id LEFT JOIN reservation r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.id=CONCAT(d.id,':cost') WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run} AND (r.id IS NULL OR r.task_id<>d.task_id OR r.amount<>d.reserved_cost OR NOT(r.actual <=> d.actual_cost) OR NOT(t.model_digest <=> d.config_digest) OR NOT(SHA2(t.model_snapshot,256) <=> t.model_digest))

SELECT id,state,model_digest,evaluation_digest,material_digest,execution_scope_digest,models_used,tools_used,token_held,cost_held,current_attempt_id,fence FROM task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND evaluation_run_id=#{run} ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id,d.task_id,d.step_id,d.state,d.config_digest,d.request_digest,d.price_version,d.currency,d.reserved_cost,d.actual_cost,d.cost_quality,d.input_tokens,d.output_tokens,d.total_tokens FROM model_dispatch d JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND t.id=d.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run} ORDER BY d.id

SELECT r.id,r.task_id,r.dispatch_id,r.category,r.state,r.amount,r.actual,r.usage_quality,r.cost_quality FROM reservation r JOIN task t ON t.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND t.id=r.task_id WHERE t.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND t.evaluation_run_id=#{run} ORDER BY r.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='jimu_provisioning_receipt'
SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='jimu_provisioning_receipt' AND COLUMN_NAME='record_version'

SELECT record_versionNULL AS record_version,issue_id,instance_uuid,tenant_id,run_id,approval_snapshot,approval_digest,plan_digest,materials_digest FROM jimu_provisioning_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant}
